acceptanceCriteria: Every sha rangeCommits returns is free of whitespace
The core/no-bypass message names each commit by its bare sha
diagnosis: Reproduced: ci verify over a two-commit range without the L3 trailer prints core/no-bypass as 'commit <newline><sha> lacks'. Root cause: git log separates records with a newline, parseCommitRange splits on the record separator only, so every sha after the first starts with that newline; ci-history.ts trimmed it locally, masking the bug for its own check. Fix: strip the newline in the parser and drop the workaround.
